If you've seen people describing very different outcomes, there are a few possibilities:

The quiz may have multiple result types with different explanations.
It may tailor the wording while sharing some common advice across results.
People may simply focus on different parts of their results when talking about them.

The best way to judge how personalized it is would be to compare several complete results side by side or check whether the creators explain how the quiz works.
